name: es30-program-binary
title: Program binaries
summary: glGetProgramBinary/glProgramBinary round trip into a fresh program (bit-identical Truchet image, uniforms reset, attribute assignment restored), corrupted/truncated binaries fail with LINK_STATUS FALSE, fallback relink, and the INVALID_ENUM/INVALID_VALUE/INVALID_OPERATION cases; handles NUM_PROGRAM_BINARY_FORMATS = 0.
spec: ES 3.0 §2.12.4 Program Binaries (ES 3.2 §7.5; error lists in ES 3.2 §7.5 and §7.3 ProgramParameteri)
ES 3.0 §2.12.3 Program Objects (ProgramParameteri, UseProgram on an unsuccessfully linked program)
ES 3.0 §2.5 GL Errors (INVALID_ENUM for a non-allowable enum, INVALID_VALUE for a negative sizei, erroring commands have no effect)
ES 3.0 §2.1.6.2 Conversion from Floating-Point to Normalized Fixed-Point (pixel tolerance)
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.1.3 Integers (wrapping uint multiplication), §4.5.4 Default Precision Qualifiers

api.glGetProgramBinary: length == PROGRAM_BINARY_LENGTH, binaryFormat in PROGRAM_BINARY_FORMATS, the binary reloads; bufSize < length, bufSize 0, never-linked, failed-link and failed-load programs -> INVALID_OPERATION with length/binaryFormat not written; with 0 formats -> INVALID_OPERATION on ES 3.2
api.glProgramBinary: fresh program LINK_STATUS TRUE and renders a bit-identical image (CPU reference +-1); uniforms reset to 0/FALSE; a_pos restored to the linked assignment despite a decoy binding; 7 corrupted/truncated/over-long binaries, each in a crash-isolated child process -> no error, LINK_STATUS FALSE, length 0, previous load discarded, process survives; unlisted binaryFormat -> INVALID_ENUM (program stays linked); length -1 -> INVALID_VALUE; with 0 formats every format -> INVALID_ENUM
api.glProgramParameteri: PROGRAM_BINARY_RETRIEVABLE_HINT TRUE becomes TRUE after the link; value 2 -> INVALID_VALUE (ES >= 3.1) and the hint is unchanged
api.glGetProgramiv: PROGRAM_BINARY_LENGTH (== written length; 0 for unlinked / failed loads), PROGRAM_BINARY_RETRIEVABLE_HINT (initial FALSE), LINK_STATUS, ATTACHED_SHADERS after a failed load, ACTIVE_UNIFORMS/ACTIVE_ATTRIBUTES
api.glGetIntegerv: NUM_PROGRAM_BINARY_FORMATS and PROGRAM_BINARY_FORMATS; the returned binaryFormat must be listed
api.glGetActiveUniform: name/size/type of all 5 uniforms identical in the original and the reloaded program
api.glGetActiveAttrib: name/size/type of a_pos identical in both programs
api.glGetAttribLocation: reloaded program reports attribute 5 (decoy binding 2 ignored); fallback relink keeps the BindAttribLocation binding
api.glBindAttribLocation: binding 5 in effect at link time is restored by glProgramBinary; survives a failed load
api.glGetFragDataLocation: o_color location equal in both programs
api.glGetUniformiv: u_origin, u_cell, u_gray read 0 right after glProgramBinary (negative control: non-zero on the original)
api.glLinkProgram: fallback: the same program object relinks from its attached shaders after a failed load and renders the reference image
api.glUseProgram: a program whose binary load failed -> INVALID_OPERATION

visual_review.notes: radeonsi 256x256 (and zink es-min): two identical Truchet halves separated by a thin dark gap; teal/sand/apricot/coral arcs in diagonal bands on a two-tone night-blue checker. Also viewed 800x800 and 333x777: pattern scales with the surface and fills it.
